cards.title: Glossary
items: 0026: ADR, the feature document is the raw request; the contract is what intake produces from it; section-to-field mapping, three template changes
0027: ADR, Anthropic's AI-native SDLC playbook mapped to the 56 conditions; its four disagreements are the rejected alternatives; six gaps close in two contracts
PR #37: self-pin, the kit's own workflow refs take the v0.12.0 tag (merged 673cc24). PR #38: notes, ADRs, CONVENTIONS line, plan (merged 7824b7a)
Two-Key: a unit is done only when the Verifier re-runs the tests independently and grades PASS
ready-green: the contract passes the ready validation profile; development starts only from green
Parked: a seat's answer is missing or a dependency is blocked; the contract validates as draft and waits
Seat: a human role that answers at intake (PO, engineer), recorded per unit in confirmed_by
G4.12: new pre-merge condition, the diff stays within its contract's scope. G9.5: new maintenance condition, a scheduled re-scan of unchanged code
Contract: trailer: the proposed binding of a commit to its contract, a git trailer like the Theory: trailer the commit hook already parses
Self-pin: after a release, the kit's own workflow refs move to the new tag; the last act of every release
PR #39: the session 30 close, plan as a step spine, STATE regenerated (merged 16426dd)
Class E: enforcement-layer paths (gate docs, committed configs, agent prompts); a change there needs PL-PIPE.1's approval record
5b: proposed step, taskcontract graph emits Archify beside its Mermaid, so a contract's picture is derived, never hand authored (0024); two units, its own contract, before the demo
I4, I5: intake flow steps, author the contract and confirm each unit with its seat; amendment 2 puts the playbook's three plan questions there

0028: ADR, the specification interview writes the feature document; a second plugin skill, /sdlc:product-specification-interview, re-cut from the user's global skill; twelve features, five non-goals; ships in 0.13.0
S1-S5: the interview's units, one commit each: USAGE section, SKILL.md, opening + sections flows, readiness + output flows, test + docs
